items.headline: First turnover of season in loss to Rams
items.text: Daniels completed 24 of 35 passes for 274 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 20-13 loss to the Rams. He also gained 16 rushing yards on four carries and lost a fumble.

items.headline: Two TDs on 20 touches in Week 9
items.text: McCaffrey rushed 18 times for 68 yards and a touchdown while catching two of three targets for 19 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 38-17 win over the Raiders.

items.headline: Rushes for team-high 70 yards
items.text: Black rushed 11 times for 70 yards but wasn't targeted in Sunday's 38-17 win over the Raiders.

items.headline: Leading receiver in Week 9 loss
items.text: London caught all five of his targets for 68 yards in Sunday's 34-17 loss to the Bengals.

items.headline: Two catches during SNF
items.text: Godwin caught two of three targets for 16 yards and added a 12-yard rush during Sunday night's 27-24 loss to the Bears.

items.headline: Team-high receiving yards in win
items.text: Kelce brought in four of six targets for 72 yards in the Chiefs' 35-12 win over the Jets on Sunday. He also rushed once for one yard.

items.headline: Just three grabs in Sunday's loss
items.text: Diggs caught three of five targets for 51 yards in Sunday's 20-13 loss to the Rams.

items.headline: Leads team in receiving yards
items.text: Douglas secured six of eight targets for 70 yards in the Dolphins' 19-9 loss to the Lions on Sunday.

items.headline: Inactive in Week 9
items.text: Pickens (hamstring) is inactive for Sunday's game at Indianapolis.

items.headline: Ties career high in rushing yards
items.text: Warren rushed 17 times for 143 yards and a touchdown and brought in one of two targets for no gain in the Steelers' 27-6 win over the Browns on Sunday. He also fumbled once but recovered.

items.headline: Won't play Sunday against Green Bay
items.text: Henderson (illness) won't play Sunday against the Packers, Evan Lazar of the Patriots' official site reports.

items.headline: Does just enough in OT win
items.text: Shough completed 21 of 35 passes for 265 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 23-22 overtime win over the Browns.

items.headline: Not practicing yet
items.text: Head coach Kellen Moore said Wednesday that the Saints haven't opened Etienne's (hamstring) practice window just yet, Jeff Nowak of WWL Radio reports.

items.headline: Likely to play Thursday, despite hip pointer
items.text: Giants head coach John Harbaugh said Monday that McCarthy is managing a hip pointer but is expected to play Thursday against the Commanders, Pat Leonard of the New York Daily News reports. "It does look like he's gonna play," Harbaugh said. "I feel fairly good about it."

items.headline: Tallies 13 touches in Week 9
items.text: Price posted nine carries for 24 yards and secured all four targets for 54 yards during Sunday's 17-3 victory versus the Cardinals.

items.headline: Cedes majority of work to Hall
items.text: Allen rushed eight times for 33 yards, caught both of his targets for 21 yards and lost a fumble in Sunday's 35-12 loss to the Chiefs.

items.headline: Dominates in Madrid
items.text: Chase caught 10 of 12 targets for 155 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 34-17 win over the Falcons.

items.headline: Pregame back spasms lead to Week 9 absence
items.text: McConkey was active but didn't play any snaps in Sunday's 44-22 loss to the Texans after experiencing back spasms during pregame workouts, Noah Furtado of The Athletic reports.

items.headline: Limited role in overtime win
items.text: Kamara rushed six times for 32 yards while catching three of four targets for 17 yards during Sunday's 23-22 overtime win against the Browns.

items.headline: Could return to practice soon
items.text: Coach DeMeco Ryans said Monday he's hopeful that Montgomery (groin) could resume practicing this week, or next week, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.

items.headline: Five catches in blowout win
items.text: Bernard caught all five of his targets for 30 yards during Sunday's 27-6 win against Cleveland.

items.headline: Modest production in Week 8 win
items.text: Rodgers completed 13 of 25 passes for 172 yards with no touchdowns and one interception in the Steelers' 27-6 win over the Browns on Sunday.

items.headline: Finds little running room in Week 9 loss
items.text: White carried the ball seven times for 28 yards and caught two of three targets for 41 yards in Sunday's 20-13 loss to the Rams.

items.headline: Finds end zone in Carolina
items.text: Coleman carried the ball 17 times for 57 yards and a touchdown and caught all four of his targets for 31 yards in Sunday's 26-21 win over the Panthers.

items.headline: Ruled out for rest of Sunday's game
items.text: Waddle (concussion) has been ruled out for the remainder of Sunday's game against the Panthers, Parker Gabriel of The Denver Post reports.

items.headline: Finds end zone against Detroit
items.text: Hockenson caught four of five targets for 58 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 19-15 loss to the Lions.

items.headline: Renews chemistry with Sanders in OT loss
items.text: Fannin caught both his targets for 42 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 23-22 overtime loss to the Saints.

items.headline: Another forgettable Week 9 line
items.text: Downs caught three of six targets for 24 yards in Sunday's 27-23 loss to the Cowboys.

items.headline: Begins running, but lacks timetable
items.text: Pittman (foot) said Monday that he resumed running last week as part of a program to return, but the wideout acknowledged that he's without a clear timeline to be activated from injured reserve, Ray Fittipaldo of the Pittsburgh Post-Gazette reports.

items.headline: Another 300-yard tally in win
items.text: Prescott completed 21 of 34 passes for 335 yards with two touchdowns and no interceptions while rushing twice for one yard in the Cowboys' 27-23 win over the Colts on Sunday. He also lost a fumble.

items.headline: Big workload in loss to Cincy
items.text: Robinson carried the ball 19 times for 100 yards and a touchdown and caught six of seven targets for 47 yards in Sunday's 34-17 loss to the Bengals.

items.headline: Stymied by Bucs
items.text: Swift rushed 12 times for 31 yards and didn't catch his lone target in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Buccaneers.

items.headline: Victim of poor QB play again
items.text: Flowers brought in three of six targets for six yards and rushed three times for 17 yards in the Ravens' 33-10 loss to the Jaguars on Thursday night.

items.headline: Picturesque TD catch in loss
items.text: Jefferson brought in five of nine targets for 33 yards and a touchdown in the Vikings' 19-15 loss to the Lions on Sunday.

items.headline: Paces pass catchers in win
items.text: Meyers brought in four of six targets for 65 yards in the Jaguars' 33-10 win over the Ravens on Thursday night.

items.headline: Logs 17 touches in Week 9 loss
items.text: Gordon rushed 16 times for 55 yards and brought in his only target for nine yards in the Dolphins' 19-9 loss to the Lions on Sunday.

items.headline: Quiet day in Week 9 win
items.text: Goff completed 17 of 25 passes for 170 yards with no touchdowns and one interception while also rushing four times for five yards in the Lions' 19-9 win over the Dolphins on Sunday.

items.headline: Single-digit yardage on three touches
items.text: Kraft brought in one of three targets for one yard and rushed twice for eight yards in the Packers' 45-27 win over the Patriots on Sunday.

items.headline: Eight catches in Wilson's absence
items.text: Cooper caught eight of 11 targets for 58 yards in Sunday's 35-12 loss to the Chiefs.

items.headline: Ties season high with 57 rec yards
items.text: Robinson caught six of seven targets for 57 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 43-36 overtime loss to the Bengals. He also lost a fumble.

items.headline: Tosses five touchdowns
items.text: Stroud completed 21 of 35 passes for 384 yards, five touchdowns and one interception and recorded two carries for 20 yards during Sunday's 44-22 win at the Chargers.

items.headline: Not expected to return Week 9
items.text: Cardinals head coach Mike LaFleur said Tuesday that Conner (foot) won't return from IR this week, Darren Urban of the team's official site reports.

items.headline: Still targeting December return
items.text: Lions coach Dan Campbell said Friday that Pacheco (back) has a chance to return in late December, Justin Rogers of DetroitFootball.net reports.

items.headline: Deemed day-to-day by Reid
items.text: Chiefs coach Andy Reid said Monday that Mahomes (elbow) is considered day-to-day as this Sunday's game against the Falcons approaches, Sam McDowell of The Kansas City Star reports.

items.headline: Ends just short of 100 scrimmage yards
items.text: Hubbard carried the ball 16 times for 79 yards and caught four of five targets for 17 yards in Sunday's 26-21 loss to Denver.

items.headline: Quiet in Week 9 win
items.text: Brown carried the ball nine times for 57 yards and caught all three of his targets for 18 yards in Sunday's 34-17 win over the Falcons.

items.headline: Standout numbers again in win
items.text: Lamb brought in 10 of 16 targets for 195 yards and a touchdown in the Cowboys' 27-23 win over the Colts on Sunday. He also lost a fumble.

items.headline: Quiet in Week 9 win
items.text: Nabers caught five of eight targets for 43 yards in Sunday's 19-11 win over the Eagles.

items.headline: Solid yardage with four catches
items.text: Warren brought in four of seven targets for 44 yards in the Colts' 27-23 loss to the Cowboys on Sunday.

items.headline: In clear for Week 9
items.text: Moore (shoulder) doesn't have a designation for Monday's contest at Minnesota.

items.headline: Hits paydirt against Washington
items.text: Corum carried the ball 11 times for 58 yards and a touchdown and failed to catch either of his two targets in Sunday's 20-13 win over the Commanders.

items.headline: Three TDs not enough Sunday
items.text: Young completed 28 of 39 passes for 276 yards and three touchdowns with one interception in Sunday's 26-21 loss to the Broncos. He added 13 yards on his only carry and lost a fumble.

items.headline: Gets 18 touches in return
items.text: Hall (quadriceps) rushed 15 times for 61 yards and caught three of four targets for 26 yards in Sunday's 35-12 loss to the Chiefs.

items.headline: IR stint appears likely
items.text: Coach Sean McVay indicated Monday that Nacua (knee) is likely headed to injured reserve with a PCL/MCL sprain and turf toe, Adam Grosbard of The Orange County Register reports.

items.headline: Notches first TD in Week 9 win
items.text: Odunze caught four of seven targets for 60 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Buccaneers.

items.headline: Matches Washington with six carries
items.text: Jeanty rushed six times for 25 yards while catching five of seven targets for minus-5 yards in Sunday's 38-17 loss to the 49ers.

items.headline: Gets into end zone Thursday
items.text: Washington secured two of seven targets for 61 yards and a touchdown in the Jaguars' 33-10 win over the Ravens on Thursday night. He also returned one punt for 11 yards.

items.headline: Two touches in Week 9 win
items.text: Williams brought in one of two targets for 31 yards and rushed once for nine yards in the Lions' 19-9 win over the Dolphins on Sunday.

items.headline: Two short TDs against Arizona
items.text: Barner caught two of four targets for seven yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 17-3 win over the Cardinals. He added three carries for three yards and an additional touchdown.

items.headline: Stretches TD streak to six games
items.text: Cook rushed 21 times for 80 yards and a touchdown while catching two of three targets for 21 yards in Sunday's 36-10 win over the Ravens.

items.headline: Another prolific performance in win
items.text: Love completed 23 of 29 passes for 372 yards with three touchdowns and no interceptions and rushed once for a 13-yard score in the Packers' 45-27 win over the Patriots on Sunday. He also ran in a two-point conversion.

items.headline: Quiet before potential trade
items.text: Taylor rushed 13 times for 46 yards and brought in all five targets for 18 yards in the Colts' 27-23 loss to the Cowboys on Sunday. He also lost a fumble.

items.headline: Three total TDs in win
items.text: Walker rushed 18 times for 102 yards and a touchdown and brought in all four targets for 41 yards and two more scores in the Chiefs' 35-12 win over the Jets on Sunday.

items.headline: Catches TD from Winston in win
items.text: Likely caught five of six targets for 53 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 19-11 win over the Eagles.

items.headline: Logs 19 more touches in Week 9
items.text: Marks turned 18 carries into 70 yards and hauled in one of four targets for four yards during Sunday's 44-22 road win over the Chargers.
